newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Port conditions update -Australia- Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update -Australia- Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: AUSTRALIA - New South Wales, Sept 10 - Understood that from September 14, shiploader no 4 at Kooragang will be taken out of service for 23 days for necessary repair work. PWCs will also take this opportunity to undertake some necessary repairs to a reclaimer in the Kooragang coal terminal stockpile area. This will effectively reduce vessel loading at the terminal to one shiploader for the duration of the repair work.
